purpose: Bounded prior-art check for the standard-parabolic negative answers to Highly symmetric hypertopes (2016), Problems 9.3–9.4.
scope_limit: These three focused checks are additional to the frozen 17 indexed followups. The 23 forward-citation metadata results were screened, not all 23 full texts read. No exhaustive priority or novelty claim.

records.title: Triples of involutions in PGL(2,q) and their incidence geometries
records.scope: Full-text lexical search; abstract, standard-parabolic definitions, Theorems 2.6–2.7 and their application to residual connectedness read. Not every construction proof read.
records.finding: Classifies a family of rank-three regular hypertopes via strongly non-self-polar triangles. Uses a flag-transitivity hypothesis when applying its general residual-connectivity criterion; no explicit resolution of the 2016 Problems 9.3–9.4 located.

records.title: Constructing new geometries: a generalized approach to halving for hypertopes
records.authors: Claudio Alexandre Piedade and Philippe Tranchida
records.scope: Full-text lexical search; abstract, incidence definitions, Theorem A, Proposition 3.13 and Theorem 3.18 contexts read. Not every construction proof read.
records.finding: Preserves residual connectedness and relates thinness/flag transitivity under explicit conditions (B1) and (B2). No explicit resolution of the 2016 Problems 9.3–9.4 located.

records.title: Proper locally spherical hypertopes of hyperbolic type
records.authors: Antonio Montero and Asia Ivić Weiss
records.scope: Full-text lexical search; abstract, hypertope definitions and conclusions read. Not the case-by-case construction proofs.
records.finding: Constructs infinite families for locally spherical hyperbolic types. No explicit resolution of the 2016 Problems 9.3–9.4 located. A later correction exists and was not read; this source is not used as a theorem dependency.

outcome: No explicit published resolution of Problems 9.3–9.4 located in this bounded check. Absence of matching text is not proof of novelty.
